verdict.rationale: The pack includes a first-party GitHub repository (github.com/crossplane/crossplane), which suggests the source is publicly readable. However, no evidence item states the license or that it is an open-source license, so only the 'readable source' half of the story is indicated. missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence (e.g., Apache-2.0 / CNCF statement), first-party docs on source availability and contribution, independent corroboration of open licensing.
